description: If induction holds for all predicates under a relation M, then every nonempty subset of its carrier has an M-minimal member.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FoundationAndRank.foundation_of_induction.{v} {α : Type v} (M : α → α → Prop)
  (h : Lemmatheca.Entry.FoundationAndRank.MembershipInduction M) (A : Set α) (hne : A.Nonempty) :
  ∃ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, ¬M b a
